watches.name: Lince Piuma
watches.description: Lince Piuma redefines lightness without compromise: an Ergal champagne-anodised case weighing just 65 grams, sapphire crystal, three-colour Italian flag accent on the bezel, and water resistance to 500 metres. Versatile enough for any occasion.

specsRaw.Lince Piuma: pushes the Lince family into new territory — a super-lightweight watch built around an Ergal case. Ready for everything: weekend sports, the working week, or a gala evening.
specsRaw.Movement: Automatico, Swiss Made — Sellita SW200. 28.800 alternanze/h (4 Hz), 26 rubini
specsRaw.Case: Realizzata in 3 parti: lunetta fissa lavorata in Ergal anodizzato champagne con 3 punti luce tricolore; corpo centrale in Ergal anodizzato champagne; fondello inciso con referenza e seriale numerico in lega di titanio grado 5, finitura micropallinata
specsRaw.Dial: Nero o blu con indici trattati con Superluminova
specsRaw.Strap: Pelle di rettile personalizzata prodotta da azienda italiana, fibbia roller in Ergal

watches.name: Lince Turquoise
watches.description: Lince Turquoise elevates the Lince family with a hand-enamelled Turquoise body, Petronas-coloured gradient dial, DOME sapphire crystal, and water resistance to 2,000 metres. Italian sportiness and elegance in perfect balance.

specsRaw.Lince Turquoise: is an evolution of the Lince — where sportiness, elegance, and Italian taste converge in a single timepiece that embodies the G.A.W. philosophy. The grade 5 titanium case delivers absolute lightness and strength.
specsRaw.Movement: Automatico, Swiss Made — Sellita SW200. 28.800 alternanze/h (4 Hz), 26 rubini
specsRaw.Case: Realizzata in 3 parti ottenute dal titanio in barra: lunetta fissa, corpo centrale con smaltatura realizzata a mano color Turquoise, fondello inciso con referenza e seriale numerico
specsRaw.Crystal: Vetro zaffiro DOME con trattamento antiriflesso, spessore 4 mm
specsRaw.Dial: Color Petronas degradè con indici trattati con Superluminova
specsRaw.Strap: Pelle di squalo realizzata a mano da artigiano italiano, fibbia in titanio personalizzata

watches.name: Lince Giallo
watches.description: Lince Giallo brings a bold 'Modena Yellow' dial to G.A.W.'s most accessible collection. Grade 5 titanium case, sapphire crystal, and water resistance to 1,000 metres. A sporty character with universal appeal.

specsRaw.Lince Giallo: is G.A.W.’s entry point into its world of precision watchmaking — a sporty yet universal timepiece, suitable for every occasion, while maintaining the high standard of craftsmanship that defines every G.A.W. watch. The grade 5 titanium case provides absolute lightness and strength.
specsRaw.Movement: Automatico, Swiss Made — Sellita SW200. 28.800 alternanze/h (4 Hz), 26 rubini
specsRaw.Case: Realizzata in 3 parti ottenute dal titanio in barra: lunetta fissa, corpo centrale, fondello inciso con referenza e seriale numerico. Lega di titanio grado 5, finitura micropallinata

specsRaw.Strap: Caucciù naturale personalizzato prodotto da azienda italiana, fibbia in acciaio personalizzata

watches.name: Kraken Kaiser
watches.description: Kraken is G.A.W.'s ultimate sports watch — a striking mix of modernity and 1970s aesthetics, extreme in every respect: design, materials, and technical performance. Grade 5 titanium, 8 mm DOME sapphire crystal, helium escape valve, and water resistance tested beyond 9,500 metres.

specsRaw.Kraken Kaiser: is G.A.W.’s flagship sports model — an immediately recognisable design that blends contemporary lines with a bold 1970s character. Extreme in every dimension: aesthetics, materials, and technical specs.

watches.description: NumeroUno Bronze embodies the concept of the 'hard watch': a CuSn12 bronze case, sapphire crystal, high-quality finishes, and extremely robust construction. Water resistant to 1,000 metres, combining bold design, noble materials, and Italian craftsmanship.

watches.name: Lince Bronzo
watches.description: Lince Bronzo swaps titanium for CuSn12 bronze — a warm, living material deeply rooted in G.A.W.'s DNA. Grade 5 titanium caseback for hypoallergenic contact, sapphire crystal, and water resistance to 1,000 metres.

specsRaw.Lince Bronzo: is a variant of the Lince in which CuSn12 bronze replaces titanium as the case material. Bronze is a warm, living material at the heart of G.A.W.’s identity: it evolves in colour with the wearer’s environment — at work, at rest, at play.

watches.name: Centauro
watches.description: Centauro is G.A.W.'s first chronograph: sporty yet occasion-ready, with a grade 5 titanium case, screw-down chrono pushers with push-indicator, helium escape valve, and water resistance to 2,000 metres — unique in the chronograph landscape.

specsRaw.Centauro is G.A.W.’s first chronograph: sporty yet occasion-ready, with a grade 5 titanium case, screw-down chrono pushers with push-indicator, helium escape valve, and water resistance to 2,000 metres — unique in the chronograph landscape.
specsRaw.Centauro: is the new chronograph from G.A.W.: a sports watch that, despite its exceptional performance, is at home on every occasion — maintaining the high standard of craftsmanship that defines the brand. The grade 5 titanium case provides absolute lightness and strength.

Handcrafted in Italy in grade 5 titanium, with sapphire crystal, matte black dial and hand-finished details. Designed to stand out, it delivers extreme robustness, a unique silhouette, and water resistance to 1,700 metres.

watches.name: Esploratore GMT
watches.description: Esploratore GMT charts new territory for G.A.W. with a compact 39 mm CuSn12 bronze case, horizontal green gradient dial, engraved and enamelled 24-hour bezel, and Swiss automatic ETA 2893/2 GMT movement. Water resistant to 1,350 metres.

specsRaw.Esploratore GMT: steps outside the familiar G.A.W. mould, offering a more compact 39 mm case while running parallel to the professional line — exploring new territory with a typically G.A.W. product: top-tier materials and the same exacting craftsmanship.
specsRaw.Functions: Ore, minuti, secondi, data, GMT (seconda timezone)
